title: Asean Summit: Cops told to respect human rights amid tighter security

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) has directed its personnel to uphold human rights and exercise professionalism as they enforce heightened security measures for the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits. “Let us perform our duties with professionalism, vigilance, and respect for human rights,” said NCRPO Acting Regional Director Brig. Gen. Christopher Abrahano in a statement on Sunday. “Our actions on the ground reflect not only the integrity of the Philippine National Police but also the hospitality and capability of our country before the international community,” he added. Earlier, tensions flared between protesters and police officers at Liwasang Bonifacio […]... Keep on reading: Asean Summit: Cops told to respect human rights amid tighter security
